step0.rule: retrained fit CLOCs-R (R0+T2+K40+RC) seed 1, val APCD at 50-200 m, equal to the stored value to 3 decimals

H2.test: camera share of CLOCs-R_sel - fit-trained CLOCs-R (6-seed means), val

H3.test: CLOCs-R_sel - CLOCs-R (fit-trained), val 50-200 m (= the change in the gap to SECOND)

H4.test: L0_sel - L0 (fit-trained), val 50-200 m; supported needs |L0_sel - SECOND| < |L0 - SECOND|
